basic_info.description: Luxury modern city living awaits you in this beautifully renovated 1BR/1BA home at the coveted 170 Off Third. Bathed in natural light, this stylish residence features new laminated flooring, designer stone countertops, a sleek backsplash, and a spacious kitchen island. The open kitchen, dining, and living area is perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The bedroom includes a generous walk-in closet with a custom closet system. The unit also includes in-unit laundry and a deeded parking space, adding everyday convenience to your lifestyle.    Resort-style amenities include a panoramic rooftop deck, heated pool & spa, fitness center, private theater,two outdoor BBQ areas, and an elegant clubhouse. This pet-friendly community is ideally located just steps from Oracle Park, Chase Center, renowned restaurants, and major transit options including Caltrain, Muni Metro, and BART. Easy access to I-280 and US-101 makes commuting around the Bay Area a breeze.    With a Walk Score of 94, Transit Score of 94, and Bike Score of 92, this home offers unmatched comfort, connectivity, and city sophistication.
